## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place the blue cup onto the disc-shaped light gray coaster.

Task description: Place the empty blue cup at the lower left of the view on the light-gray round coaster behind and to its right so the coaster supports the cup.

Success criteria: The bottom of the blue cup is placed on the coaster surface, with the cup horizontally aligned near the coaster and not visibly suspended; both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping an unobstructed section of mug wall facing the image bottom, one finger inside and one outside, with pads below the rim. Match the opening to wall thickness and finger-entry clearance to reduce slippage from gripping only the thin edge.
- Before closing, confirm that both fingers are on the inside and outside of the cup wall rather than merely overlapping in the image and actually resting on the rim or the same side of the wall.
- Keep the cup opening upward and base off the table during transport. Adjust its pose in an open area to avoid dragging the base or sweeping into the tall bottle behind the coaster.
- Lower the cup base gradually and release only after the coaster supports it. When withdrawing the inner finger, leave clearance from the rim to avoid catching the opening and tipping the cup.
